### Program Outcomes [po] for PG-Design
1) Anability toindependently carryoutresearch/investigationanddevelopmentworktosolve practical problems
2) An abilityto write and present a substantial technical report/document
3) Students should be able todemonstrate a degree of mastery over the area as per the specialization of the program. The mastery should be at a level higher than the requirements in the appropriate bachelor program.

### Program Specific Outcomes [pso] for PG-Design
1.      To critically analyze/synthesize, simulate and optimize mechanical systems, components and processes by applying the principles of design engineering.
2.      Student will be able to investigate and provide solutions to complex real life interdisciplinary problems using modern tools of design engineering
